state.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station Rebate Program
state.sum: The Maryland Energy Administration (MEA) offers a rebate to individuals, businesses, multi-family housing (MFH), and state or local government entities for the costs of acquiring and installing qualified EV chargers.

state.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) and Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle (FCEV) Tax Credit
state.sum: Beginning July 1, 2023, qualified EV and FCEV purchasers may apply for an excise tax credit of up to $3,000. The tax credit is first-come, first-served, and is limited to one vehicle per individual and 10 vehicles per business entity.

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Policies for Associations
laws.sum: Homeowner associations or condominium associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of an EV charger in a homeowner’s designated parking space.
laws.ref: Maryland Statutes, Real Property Code 11-111.4 and 11B-111.8
